caption: The drawing depicts a sofa with a dark gray upholstered seat, back, and arms, all trimmed with a row of closely spaced brass or gold-colored decorative tacks. The frame and arms of the sofa are constructed from a wood material that is illustrated in shades of reddish-brown, with visible grain patterns and scroll detailing at the armrests and back-support sections. The sofa features four carved wooden legs, each with ornate foliage-like designs and terminating in animal paw feet fitted with small metal casters. The background is a plain, unadorned light beige color with no other objects present.
title: Sofa
